name: PresideCMS Extension: Tiptap
author: Pixl8 Group
shortDescription: Tiptap (v3) rich-editor for Preside. Drop-in replacement for the vendored CKEditor 4, preserving Preside's content tokens, pickers and renderers.
description: A self-contained Tiptap v3 based rich editor that replaces Preside's legacy CKEditor 4. It reproduces the Preside integration contract - the {{image}}/{{attachment}}/{{widget}} content tokens, the link/asset/widget picker iframe protocol, the CKEDITOR.instances registry and the PresideRichEditor facade - so all server-side forms, renderers, AJAX endpoints and pickers keep working unchanged. Overrides core Sticker asset ids and the ckEditorJs.cfm view from within the extension, so no core Preside files are edited.
